name: Ancient Burial Sites
description: At the start of the agenda phase: Choose 1 player. Exhaust each cultural planet owned by that player.

name: Archaeological Expedition
description: Action: Reveal the top 3 cards of an exploration deck that matches a planet you control; gain any relic fragments that you reveal and discard the rest.

name: Assassinate Representative
description: After an agenda is revealed: Choose 1 player. That player cannot vote on this agenda.

name: Black Market Dealings
description: When you are negotiating a transaction: You and the other player may include relics, action cards, and unscored secret objectives as part of the transaction. This card cannot be canceled.

name: Blitz
description: At the start of an invasion: Each of your non-fighter ships in the active system that do not have BOMBARDMENT gain BOMBARDMENT 6 until the end of the invasion.

name: Bribery
description: After the speaker votes on an agenda: Spend any number of trade goods. For each trade good spent, cast 1 additional vote for the outcome on which you voted.

name: Brilliance
description: Action: Ready 1 of your planets that has a technology specialty or choose 1 player to gain their breakthrough.

name: Bunker
description: At the start of an invasion: During this invasion, apply -4 to the result of each BOMBARDMENT roll against planets you control.

name: Confounding Legal Text
description: When another player is elected as the outcome of an agenda: You are the elected player instead.

name: Confusing Legal Text
description: When you are elected as the outcome of an agenda: Choose 1 player. That player is the elected player instead.

name: Construction Rider
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

name: Counterstroke
description: After another player activates a system that contains 1 of your command tokens: Return that command token to your tactic pool.

name: Coup d'Etat
description: When another player would perform a strategic action: End that player's turn, the strategic action is not resolved and the strategy card is not exhausted.

name: Courageous to the End
description: After 1 of your ships is destroyed during a space combat: Roll 2 dice. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, your opponent must choose and destroy 1 of their ships.

name: Crash Landing
description: When your last ship in the active system is destroyed: Place 1 of your ground forces from the space area of the active system onto a planet in that system other than Mecatol Rex; if the planet contains other players' units, place your ground force into coexistence.

name: Cripple Defenses
description: Action: Choose 1 planet. Destroy each PDS on that planet.

name: Crisis
description: At the end of any players turn, if there are at least 2 players who have not passed: Skip the next player's turn.

name: Deadly Plot
description: During the agenda phase when an outcome would be resolved: If you voted for or predicted another outcome, discard the agenda instead. The agenda is resolved with no effect and it is not replaced. Then, exhaust all of your planets.

name: Decoy Operation
description: After another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your structures: Remove up to 2 of your ground forces from the game board and place them on a planet you control in the active system.

name: Diplomacy Rider
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, choose 1 system that contains a planet you control. Each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in that system.

name: Diplomatic Pressure
description: When an agenda is revealed: Choose another player. That player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand.

name: Direct Hit
description: After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE to cancel a hit produced by your units or abilities: Destroy that ship.

name: Disable
description: At the start of an invasion in a system that contains 1 or more of your opponents' PDS units: Your opponents' PDS units lose PLANETARY SHIELD and SPACE CANNON during this invasion.

name: Distinguished Councilor
description: After you cast votes on an outcome of an agenda: Cast 5 additional votes for that outcome.

name: Divert Funding
description: Action: Return a non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology that you own to your technology deck. Then, research another technology.

name: Economic Initiative
description: Action: Ready each cultural planet you control.

name: Emergency Repairs
description: At the start or end of a combat round: Repair all of your units that have SUSTAIN DAMAGE in the active system.

name: Exchange Program
description: Action: Choose another player. You and that player may agree to place 1 infantry from each of your reinforcements into coexistence on a planet the other player controls that contains their ground forces; if no agreement is reached, you each discard 1 token from your fleet pool.

name: Experimental Battlestation
description: After the active player moves ships into the active system during a tactical action: Choose 1 of your space docks that is either in or adjacent to that system. That space dock uses SPACE CANNON 5(x3) against the active player's ships in the active system.

name: Exploration Probe
description: Action: Explore a frontier token that is in or adjacent to a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

name: Extreme Duress
description: At the start of another player's turn, if they have a readied strategy card: If that player's next action is not a strategic action, they discard all of their action cards, give you all of their trade goods, and show you all of their secret objectives.

name: Fighter Conscription
description: Action: Place 1 fighter from your reinforcements in each system that contains 1 or more of your space docks or units that have capacity. They cannot be placed in systems that contain other players' ships.

name: Fighter Prototype
description: At the start of the first round of a space combat: Apply +2 to the result of each of your fighters' combat rolls during this combat round.

name: Fire Team
description: After your ground forces make combat rolls during a round of ground combat: Reroll any number of your dice.

name: Flank Speed
description: After you activate a system: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.

name: Focused Research
description: Action: Spend 4 trade goods to research 1 technology

name: Forward Supply Base
description: After another player activates a system that contains your units: Gain 3 trade goods. Then, choose another player to gain 1 trade good.

name: Frontline Deployment
description: Action: Place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.

name: Ghost Ship
description: Action: Place 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a non-home system that contains a wormhole and does not contain other players' ships.

name: Ghost Squad
description: After another player commits units to land on a planet you control: Move any number of your ground forces from any planet you control in the active system to any other planet you control in the active system.

name: Hack Election
description: After an agenda is revealed: During this agenda, you vote last.

name: Harness Energy
description: After you activate an anomaly: Replenish your commodities.

name: Imperial Rider
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 victory point.

name: Impersonation
description: Action: Spend 3 influence to draw 1 secret objective.

name: In The Silence Of Space
description: After you activate a system: Choose 1 system. During this tactical action, your ships in the chosen system can move through systems that contain other players' ships.

name: Industrial Initiative
description: Action: Gain 1 trade good for each industrial planet you control.

name: Infiltrate
description: When you gain control of a planet: Replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.

name: Insider Information
description: After an agenda is revealed: Look at the top 3 cards of the agenda deck.

name: Insubordination
description: Action: Remove 1 token from another player's tactic pool and return it to their reinforcements.

name: Intercept
description: After your opponent declares a retreat during a space combat: Your opponent cannot retreat during this round of space combat.

name: Leadership Rider
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 3 command tokens.

name: Lie in Wait
description: After 2 of your neighbors resolve a transaction: Look at each of those players' hands of action cards, then choose and take 1 action card from each.

name: Lost Star Chart
description: After you activate a system: During this tactical action, systems that contain alpha and beta wormholes are adjacent to each other.

name: Lucky Shot
description: Action: Destroy 1 dreadnought, cruiser, or destroyer in a system that contains a planet you control.

name: Maneuvering Jets
description: Before you assign hits produced by another player's SPACE CANNON roll: Cancel 1 hit.

name: Manipulate Investments
description: At the start of the strategy phase: Place a total of 5 trade goods from the supply on strategy cards of your choice. You must place these tokens on at least 3 different cards.

name: Master Plan
description: After you perform an action: Perform an additional action.

name: Mercenary Contract
description: Action: Spend 2 trade goods to place 2 neutral infantry on any non-home planet that contains no units; if that planet was owned by another player, they return its planet card to the planet card deck.

name: Mining Initiative
description: Action: Gain trade goods equal to the resource value of 1 planet you control.

name: Morale Boost
description: At the start of a combat round: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.

name: Nav Suite
description: After you activate a system: During the 'Movement' step of this tactical action, ignore the effect of anomalies.

name: Overrule
description: Action: Perform the primary ability of a readied or unchosen strategy card.

name: Parley
description: After another player commits units to land on a planet you control: Return the committed units to the space area.

name: Pirate Contract
description: Action: Place 1 neutral destroyer in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.

name: Pirate Fleet
description: Action: Spend 3 resources to place 1 neutral carrier, 1 neutral cruiser, 1 neutral destroyer, and 2 neutral fighters in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships.

name: Plagiarize
description: Action: Spend 5 influence and choose a non-faction technology owned by 1 of your neighbors. Gain that technology.

name: Plague
description: Action: Choose 1 planet that is controlled by another player. Roll 1 die for each infantry on that planet. For each result of 6 or greater, destroy 1 of those units.

name: Political Stability
description: When you would return your strategy card(s) during the status phase: Do not return your strategy card(s). You do not choose strategy cards during the next strategy phase.

name: Politics Rider
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 3 action cards and gain the speaker token.

name: Public Disgrace
description: When another player chooses a strategy card during the strategy phase: That player must choose a different strategy card instead, if able.

name: Puppets on a String
description: At the end of a player's turn, if you have passed: Perform 1 action.

name: Rally
description: After you activate a system that contains another player's ships: Place 2 command tokens from your reinforcements in your fleet pool.

name: Reactor Meltdown
description: Action: Destroy 1 space dock in a non-home system.

name: Refit Troops
description: Action: Choose 1 or 2 of your infantry on the game board. Replace each of those infantry with mechs.

name: Reflective Shielding
description: When one of your ships uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE during combat: Produce 2 hits against your opponent's ships in the active system.

name: Reparations
description: After another player gains control of a planet you control: Exhaust 1 planet that player controls and ready 1 planet you control.

name: Repeal Law
description: Action: Discard 1 law from play.

name: Rescue
description: After another player moves ships into a system that contains your ships: You may move 1 of your ships into the active system from any system that does not contain one of your command tokens.

name: Reveal Prototype
description: At the start of a combat: Spend 4 resources to research a unit upgrade technology of the same type as 1 of your units that is participating in this combat.

name: Reverse Engineer
description: After another player discards an action card that has a component action: Take that action card from the discard pile.

name: Rise of a Messiah
description: Action: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on each planet you control.

name: Rout
description: At the start of the 'Announce Retreats' step of space combat, if you are the defender: Your opponent must announce a retreat, if able.

name: Sabotage
description: When another player plays an action card other than 'Sabotage': Cancel that action card.

name: Salvage
description: After you win a space combat: Your opponent gives you all of their commodities.

name: Sanction
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, each player that voted for that outcome returns 1 command token from their fleet supply to their reinforcements.

name: Scramble Frequency
description: After another player makes a BOMBARDMENT, SPACE CANNON, or ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE roll: That player rerolls all of their dice.

name: Scuttle
description: Action: Choose 1 or 2 of your non-fighter ships on the game board and return them to your reinforcements. Gain trade goods equal to the combined cost of those ships.

name: Seize Artifact
description: Action: Choose 1 of your neighbors that has 1 or more relic fragments. That player must give you 1 relic fragment of your choice.

name: Shields Holding
description: Before you assign hits to your ships during a space combat: Cancel up to 2 hits.

name: Signal Jamming
description: Action: Choose 1 non-home system that contains or is adjacent to 1 of your ships. Place a command token from another player's reinforcements in that system.

name: Skilled Retreat
description: At the start of a combat round: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.

name: Solar Flare
description: After you activate a system: During the "Movement" step of this tactical action, other players cannot use SPACE CANNON against your ships.

name: Spy
description: Action: Choose 1 player. That player gives you 1 random action card from their hand.

name: Strategize
description: Action: Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card.

name: Summit
description: At the start of the strategy phase: Gain 2 command tokens.

name: Tactical Bombardment
description: Action: Choose 1 system that contains 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT. Exhaust each planet controlled by other players in that system.

name: Technology Rider
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, research 1 technology.

name: Trade Rider
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 5 trade goods.

name: Unexpected Action
description: Action: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board and return it to your reinforcements.

name: Unstable Planet
description: Action: Choose 1 hazardous planet. Exhaust that planet and destroy up to 3 infantry on it.

name: Upgrade
description: After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your ships: Replace 1 of your cruisers in that system with 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements.

name: Uprising
description: Action: Exhaust 1 non-home planet controlled by another player. Then gain trade goods equal to its resource value.

name: Veto
description: When an agenda is revealed: Discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.

name: War Effort
description: Action: Place 1 cruiser from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

name: War Machine
description: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION: Apply +4 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

name: Warfare Rider
description: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

name: Waylay
description: Before you roll dice for ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE: Hits from this roll are produced against all ships (not just fighters).
